1.web: Look! Praise Yahweh, all you servants of Yahweh, who stand by night in Yahweh’s house!
1.asv: Behold, bless ye Jehovah, all ye servants of Jehovah, That by night stand in the house of Jehovah.

2.web: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise Yahweh!
2.asv: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary, And bless ye Jehovah.

3.web: May Yahweh bless you from Zion; even he who made heaven and earth.
3.asv: Jehovah bless thee out of Zion; Even he that made heaven and earth.
